title: Hocus Pocus (franchise) — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
Every serious account of Hocus Pocus (franchise) eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. Hocus Pocus is an American media franchise consisting of two films, a sequel novelization, and other Disney media and merchandise. 300 years ago, in 1693, in Salem, Massachusetts, the Sanderson sisters were hanged by the population of Salem after a boy named Thackery Binx tried to stop the witches and was turned into an immortal black cat while saving his sister Emily.

Nothing in Hocus Pocus (franchise) was built for you — it was built for reproduction. Since 2009, "I Put a Spell on You" which features prominently in the first movie, plays during the audience exit for the fireworks show Halloween Screams for Mickey's Halloween Party at Disneyland. On July 4, 2023, Hocus Pocus: The Sanderson Sisters’ Cottage (set number: 21341) was released and is based on a scene from the first Hocus Pocus.
